title: FESCO Chief and Sons Named in Money Laundering Case
excerpt: Authorities have registered a money laundering case against the Faisalabad Electric Supply Company CEO and his three sons.
body_html:
Authorities have officially registered a money laundering case against Faisalabad Electric Supply Company (FESCO) Chief Executive Officer Muhammad Amir and his three sons.

Details regarding the ongoing investigation and specific allegations are yet to be fully disclosed, as the case has just recently been initiated by officials.
